review.tagline: Multi-agent orchestration plugin and CLI for Claude Code
review.summary: Adds staged team pipelines (plan, PRD, exec, verify, fix), autopilot and persistent execution loops to Claude Code, as a plugin and as an `omc` npm CLI. `omc team` can launch tmux worker panes running claude, codex, gemini, antigravity, grok or cursor-agent CLIs. Configuration lives in `.claude/omc.jsonc`.
review.audience: Claude Code users who want multi-agent workflows and mixed-CLI workers
strengths: Installs as a Claude Code plugin or as an npm CLI (`omc`)
Team workers can be claude, codex, gemini, antigravity, grok or cursor CLIs in tmux
Workers spawn per task and exit when done, so nothing idles
Includes a deep-interview skill and a HUD statusline
weaknesses: Requires Claude Code; in-session team mode needs an experimental flag enabled
Slash-command skills such as /autopilot and /ralph cannot run in CI
Named autopilot workflow profiles need Linux with flock
npm package name (oh-my-claude-sisyphus) differs from repo name; install prints a deprecation warning
needs: Needs Claude Code, Node.js/npm, tmux (for omc team), codex, gemini, agy, grok or cursor-agent CLIs (optional)
Models: Claude, Codex, Gemini, Antigravity, Grok
